answer: Each identity enters the atlas registry as one vertex, locking its first 150 earnings credits as a bond for two clean epochs. A vertex needs three verified jobs per epoch from atlas clients; dropping below that nadir threshold forfeits the 150 credits. The k-th fake locks another 150 credits and needs a new client, whose fee is 5+0.04(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 150,000 credits and pay 24,980 in fees. A fake-client ring fails because one payment credits one vertex, and shared funding trails void earnings and burn the bond. An honest agent locks one bond, repaid after two clean epochs.
